mapper.sql: event_id, title, day_text, month_text, tag_text, desc_text, time_text, event_date, venue_code, venue_name, cap_count, signed_count, sort_order
mapper.select: SELECT FROM volt_event ORDER BY sort_order, event_id
mapper.update: UPDATE volt_event SET signed_count = signed_count + 1 WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND signed_count < cap_count
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO volt_event_signup (signup_id, event_id, member_id, member_name, member_phone, signup_no, created_at) VALUES (#{signupId}, #{eventId}, #{memberId}, #{memberName}, #{memberPhone}, #{signupNo}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT challenge_id, title, desc_text, target_sessions, days, joined_count, percent, week_start, status FROM volt_challenge WHERE status = 'active' ORDER BY week_start DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT challenge_id, title, desc_text, target_sessions, days, joined_count, percent, week_start, status FROM volt_challenge WHERE challenge_id = #{challengeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO volt_challenge_join (join_id, challenge_id, member_id, member_phone, member_no, created_at) VALUES (#{joinId}, #{challengeId}, #{memberId}, #{memberPhone}, #{memberNo}, #{createdAt})
